messages:
alex.jones: Hey all — I’m Alex, starting today. Trying to activate Okta but the activation link says my email isn’t in the org.

alex.jones: Error shows:
```
SSO error: domain mismatch: account not linked to org (domain: redwood-acme.com)
```

sam-it: welcome! @alex.jones — do you have both personal and company emails on the invite? sometimes alias propagation from Google takes a few mins. can you paste the invite URL (redact token)?

alex.jones: I signed up with alex.personal@gmail.com first, then tried to use alex@redwood-internal.com. invite token: https://okta.redwood.com/invite/XXX (redacted)

julia-peopleops: hi Alex — welcome! we recently had a couple of hires hit alias timing issues. @sam-it i’ll kick a manual directory sync and confirm the primary alias. 1Password seat too — did you get that invite?

onboarding-bot: Directory sync queued for alex.jones (user id u_9876). job id: sync-2328461200. status: started.

sam-it: manual sync started. quick note: Oktas SAML mapping expects the Google primary email to match. if you used personal email first, Okta wont link until the corporate alias is primary.

alex.jones: ah ok. also MFA step asks for SMS — my SIM is intl and wont receive sms. can I enroll a passkey or Yubi instead?

devex: yes, passkeys and Yubi are supported. @samir-security can you confirm temporary passkey enrollment is allowed for new hires without SMS?

samir-security: Confirmed. org policy allows WebAuthn enrollment as MFA fallback. You can also use an authenticator app (TOTP). If youd like a YubiKey shipped, DM me with your address.

onboarding-bot: Directory sync complete for alex.jones. status: success. changes: primary_email set to alex@redwood-internal.com

sam-it: try the Okta link again @alex.jones

alex.jones: that did it — Okta redirected to Google SSO and I could enroll a passkey. 1Password invite still pending though.

julia-peopleops: resent 1Password to alex@redwood-internal.com. check spam. adding you to #eng and #devex now.

alex.jones: got it — 1Password + passkey set. Can I get access to team drive folders? I need access to /eng/infra and /projects/launch.

sam-it: group perms should populate within ~30 mins after sync. i’ll monitor and escalate if not.

alex.jones: amazing, thanks everyone :party_parrot: :thumbsup:

julia-peopleops: Welcome aboard again! ping this thread if anything else blocks your first-day setup.
